mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST drops more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which is a strong indicator of economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening supply side of the economy, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k MoM and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases more than 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is high, it indicates stagflation, which is a negative indicator for economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0% YoY and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is negative and CPIAUCSL growth is above 3% year-over-year.
